summary: L-4 cab on the Payette National Forest, built 1932 and still used for summer fire detection; registered with the NHLR in 2020.

access.note: An active fire lookout. The Forest Service asks visitors to be respectful of the lookout and its space. No source read says whether visitors may enter the cab.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in. Trail #073 is 7.2 miles long and starts at the Williams Peak Trailhead, reached by about 35 miles of Lick Creek Road from McCall, then about two miles on the East Fork Road. The Forest Service calls Lick Creek Road rough and narrow.

events.note: L-4 cab built on a ridge northwest of the summit. The NHLR calls it an R1/L-4 ground cabin.

Helicopter 5EV crashed on August 13, 2006, while on a mission on the East Fork South Fork of the Salmon River. Idaho Fire Lookouts, relaying a Payette National Forest Facebook post, says four people died, including the lookout Lillian Patten.
Lillian Patten listed as known staff for 2006.
Daniel Moak listed as known staff for 2017 through 2025 by Idaho Fire Lookouts.
Registered October 4, 2020. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the same year for the addition to the Register.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 6,842 ft (2,085 m). The Forest Service trailhead page and firelookout.com give 6,826 ft. The story gives the Forest Service figure and reports the NHLR figure.

notes_for_editor: Access 'restricted' is inferred from the Forest Service's active-lookout and respect-the-space wording; no source says the cab is closed to visitors, so the story says so. Elevation: the record's elevation_m 2085.4 follows NHLR (6,842 ft); the Forest Service gives 6,826 ft (about 2080.6 m). Editor to decide whether to change it; not proposed as a correction. The 2006 crash is relayed secondhand through Idaho Fire Lookouts from a Forest Service Facebook post, which was not fetched directly. Staffing 2026 is from the trailhead page's last update (May 2026). No rental found.
